author: A

components.title: Dedupe and filter orders
components.what: Remove exact duplicate order rows and keep only shipped/pending orders.

components.title: Compute per-customer revenue
components.what: Sum units x unit_price for each customer from filtered orders.

components.title: Compute total revenue and max
components.what: Sum all customer revenues for total, and identify the highest single customer revenue.

components.title: Calculate percentage
components.what: Divide top customer revenue by total revenue and express as a percentage to one decimal place.
